page_title: Serial port peripheral 232 transparent transmission configuration and use
page_content:
[TOC]

### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR 232 IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| Transparent transmission server | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- The function is to forward some 232 protocol peripherals to the transparent transmission server through the device

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
For specific peripherals to connect, refer to the above serial port configuration and usage document

#### 2. Device menu configuration
2.1 Remote control enters menu>>Settings>>Serial>>Serial, serial port index configuration RS232, serial port function transparent transmission, baud rate configuration 4800, other parameters default, confirm and save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fe41589015691cb6d081ee7639cffe74)

2.2 Press the return button on the remote control to enter the Settings>>Network Settings>>Center Menu interface, move to the bottom bar to fill in the transparent server address and port, confirm to save and restart to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e77e49832e18ea15b3c18a18e65f1d14)

#### 3. Test
After the peripheral is connected to the device, the device sends the peripheral data to the registered transparent server through 4G or other networks.
